method: parse_env_cfg only; no environment creation, simulation, or GPU execution; full physics.to_dict after historical recipe overrides
comparison_limitations: Historical JSON records only a subset of physics settings. A match verifies the recorded fields, not undocumented historical scalar values or full physics equivalence.
The AnymalD 8990-us recipe is anymald_shf, which differs from the older AnymalD entry in profile_artifacts_20260910/remeasure.sh.

AnymalD and Allegro retain scalar pgs_iterations of 8 and 12, but eligible worlds use up to 24 parallel projection sweeps, Nesterov momentum and a different friction projection metric; section 5.1 of HANDOFF_fpgs_20260911.md documents distinct converged velocities.
grouped_dynamics changes FK/inverse-dynamics scheduling; alone it does not enable the parallel contact solver.
collision_cfg=null selects the default Newton collision pipeline for FeatherPGS; it does not disable collisions.
common_environment represents the sweep process environment; FeatherPGS-specific flags have no effect on the MJWarp solver.

iteration_semantics.eligible_worlds_algorithm: scaled parallel projection with Nesterov momentum and per-contact friction-pair projection
iteration_semantics.ineligible_worlds: retained legacy path using configured pgs_iterations
